book.name: Hibulu
book.title: Me niŋdi Hibulu metamdok mede youyemguk

content: Bepaŋdi Jesu siloŋ kwanai diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum hatidok nindapmaguk
Kwetfoloŋme indi’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋnik foloŋ Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ wapuhi yapmegiŋ adi hogohogok adi meeniŋ’walaŋ yom doktiŋa Bepaŋ dumuŋ hemiŋdok yapmegiŋ.
Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ undiniŋ adi ne me gweheyeeŋ hatilak doktiŋa meeniŋ nadidakale hinek mu tiiŋ be gweheyehi tikamanda gineŋ maiŋ adi kedem kulemaŋgoŋ yenindidimeeŋ yanagitak.
Ala mebi unduŋ doktiŋa meeniŋ noli’walaŋ yom doktiŋa eŋ ne’walaŋ yomdok maaŋ dumuŋ hemindok yoŋit.
Kwanai kakaaŋ undiniŋ adi me niŋdi ne nadigoŋ tiŋa titiŋdok tuwot moŋ. Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ wapum niŋ adi Bepaŋ negoŋ kadakaleeŋ kwanai mimbune kedem tibek. Alon adi undugoŋ timiŋguk.
Kaŋ Kilisto adi maaŋ undugoŋ netok nadiune loloŋnit tubune siloŋ kwanai diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum mu tuguk. Uyadi Bepaŋdi indiŋ yoŋa miŋguk,

content.text: Nu kamiŋ tububihila du’walaŋ baha tilat.”

content: Jesu adi kwetfoloŋ hatiguk nai uŋaniŋ Bepaŋdi tubulodaune mu kumundok nadiŋa kobulabulaye wapum tiŋa ninadiguk. Unduŋ tiŋa Bepaŋdok nadiune loune gikiŋgoŋ timiŋguk doktiŋa nadimiŋguk.
Adi Bepaŋ mihiŋiŋ hatiguk iŋgoŋ fiit folofigita nadiguk wondi tubulodaune mede tiloloŋ diniŋ mebi naditomguk.
Tiŋa nemenemek tubudapmaaŋ Jesu ne hatihati fafaŋeniŋ diniŋ talik yeme tuguk. Unduŋ tiŋa metam mede tiloloŋ timiiŋ hogohogok aditok hatihati fafaŋeniŋ diniŋ talik dilitomyemulak.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, adigoŋ hinek siloŋ kwanai diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum tiŋa Melikisedekdi hatiguk wondok tuwolit hatidok Bepaŋdi nindapmaguk.
Wendiniŋ medeŋiŋ fee hatak, iŋgoŋ hidi nadilakata tiiŋ doktiŋa hanindidimedok nadiwene malabudalak.

Hidi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ koomkwaha nadigiŋ ale hidibo meeniŋ noli yeniyehitubu-didime tubune tuwot tibek oŋ. Kaŋ hidi yadi tobo Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede agaŋ miŋgoŋ hatak u kotigoŋ haniŋdok undiniŋ tiiŋ. Hidi yadi nanaŋe fafaŋeniŋ nanaŋdok tuwot mu tiiŋ, hidi yadi nom nanaŋdok undiniŋ hatiiŋ.
Nom naiŋ adi wapmihi-kabe yenindok, undihiyeŋ mede folooŋ deti nadidakaleneŋ?
Nanaŋe fafaŋeniŋ adi meeniŋ wapuhidi nanaŋdok. Kwanai tige tige welehikdi nadidakaleeŋ fofooŋ be kadakaniŋ diniŋ mebi naditomiiŋ, aditok hogok.
